تستنبئي (form X)
# تَسْتَنْبِئِي (tastanbiʔī) /tas.tan.bi.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# تُسْتَنْبَئِي (tustanbaʔī) /tus.tan.ba.ʔiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
